AUDIT INSERT, UPDATE ON oe.customers WHENEVER NOT SUCCESSFUL;

AUDIT POLICY table_pol EXCEPT hr WHENEVER SUCCESSFUL;
AUDIT CONTEXT NAMESPACE userenv ATTRIBUTES current_user, db_name BY hr;
AUDIT CREATE ANY TABLE BY SESSION;
